IMAGEM 1 = foto real do trailer Mônaco por fora; replique esse trailer com fidelidade total (forma, cor, escada, portas e decoração) e construa em volta a cena da festa com a equipe de limpeza, um convidado e duas pessoas prestes a entrar. scene.description: Vertical 4:5 cinematic editorial photograph at golden hour into dusk: the white luxury Mônaco mobile restroom trailer seen from the outside, both side doors open so the warm lit cabines are visible inside, set on a lawn at an elegant outdoor party with a white tent, string lights and guests softly out of focus in the background. The trailer must replicate IMAGEM 1 exactly (shape, colour, steps, doors, decoration). In the middle ground, right beside the trailer, a member of the Mônaco cleaning team in a neutral navy uniform (no printed logo or text) is wiping the handrail and checking the entrance, while a guest in festive clothes talks with them, relaxed and smiling. At the open steps, two guests (a man in a light suit and a woman in a dress) are walking up, about to enter the cabines, calm and comfortable. Mood: organised, welcoming, five-star hospitality at an outdoor event. Top 340px left as open sky and tent for the headline. Palette: warm gold, white trailer, deep navy dusk sky, navy #0F1D45 gradient at the top.
scene.subject: Mônaco trailer with open doors, cleaning team member with a guest, two guests about to enter
scene.setting: outdoor party on a lawn with tent and string lights at golden hour
scene.action: cleaning crew caring for the entrance while two guests are about to use the cabines

style.surface_textures: glossy white paint, brushed metal steps, warm glass, fabric of festive clothing, soft lawn
style.lighting: golden hour key light from camera-right, warm interior glow from the open doors, cool dusk fill in the sky, string lights bokeh in the background

camera.depth_of_field: moderate: trailer, crew and guests sharp, background guests soft
camera.angle: eye level, three-quarter view of the trailer

technical.resolution: ultra high definition, upscale to 1088x1360 then resize to 1080x1350
technical.rendering: natural skin texture, fine grain, warm editorial colour grade

materials.skin: real pores, natural expressions, diverse guests, no plastic smoothing
materials.fabric: navy staff uniform without text, linen suit, flowing dress
materials.surfaces: white trailer paint with soft reflections, metal steps
materials.transparency: warm light visible through open doors

environment.particles: faint warm light bloom from string lights

avoid: printed text or logos on uniforms

text_rules.textos_permitidos_na_imagem: somente os campos headline, tagline e os textos da logo anexada

negative_rules: NUNCA redesenhar, recriar, estilizar ou recolorir a logo anexada

NUNCA fonte de sistema generica (Arial, Times New Roman) na headline
NUNCA mais de 3 linhas de headline
NUNCA logos de terceiros, marcas ou textos extras na cena (exceto os itens da prancheta no slide 1)
NUNCA deixar placeholders {{...}} escritos na imagem
Pelo template, nesta cena PODE acrescentar pessoas, festa e equipe em volta do trailer; o trailer em si NUNCA e redesenhado
NUNCA texto ou logo no uniforme da equipe
NUNCA fila ou aglomeracao esperando para entrar
